name: Permits & Licensing Committee Special Meeting
minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MINUTES
  February 11, 2026

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted at City Hall, Community Room
“A” 1st Floor on February 11, 2026, at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration Department
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Service Department

  Staff Present:
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Mayra C. Perez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments, any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Christine Rivera asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits &
License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Christine Rivera reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Darnell Smith on behalf of Hoop and Icons to host a Hoops Icons Community
  Basketball & Culture Event at Parking Lot Z, Hollywood Park; Private Property, on
  Thursday, February 12, 2026, from 2:30 p.m. to  9:00 p.m. APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY; Approval for one (1) day event within Hollywood Park parking
  lot. Applicant is responsible for crowd control, event clean-up, and all applicable
  mitigation measures. APPROVED: Applicant will need to hire sufficient Hollywood
  Park Entertainment Campus Security to ensure attendee safety. NO alcoholic
  beverages to be served at this event. Adhere to all local, state, and federal laws.
  None Code Enforcement Conditions; None additional conditions for Fire approval;
  Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of
  the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, protective personal hygiene, and face mask wearing safety guidelines
  set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and
  Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code
  rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously
  (Activity No. 00426584)
 Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Permits & License Committee on any matter with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time. Adjournment
